audit.why: Poppy owns levels 1-5 on wall windows, Gwen takes 6 on Hallowed Mist and Needlework, and the game belongs to Gwen at two AP items. 54.98% over 311 games and a 9.5/10 carry threat fit that.

Both layers already agree row-for-row and match the mirror's fix (Levels 1 and 2 Poppy, Level 6 Gwen). Only First item differs from the packet (page says Poppy, packet says Skill), and whys[5] argues for Poppy there, so I left the chart alone rather than break agreement over one unsupported row.
audit.corrected: Chart unchanged; spikes and phase texts sharpened with real cooldowns instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's advice about Hallowed Mist was 'don't dive into her mist' and 'wait it out'. That is backwards as written: Riot's text is 'She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist' — standing outside is exactly what makes your targeted E useless, and stepping inside is what restores your ability to touch her.
audit.why: Heroic Charge is a targeted dash and Keeper's Verdict has a 500 range; from outside the cloud neither can select her. Entering is the counterplay, with the caveat that she fights back at full strength inside.
audit.corrected: Stated in tradeBad, dosFull[2].d, whys[4], mid, spikes[1].text, wants.foe[0] and breakdown.cooldowns, with the 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Skip 'n Slash was named as the cooldown to track with no number, and the page implied W simply disables it.
audit.why: Skip 'n Slash is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s and is partially refunded whenever she hits something during the window, so it does not stay down. The real timer worth tracking is Hallowed Mist at 22s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d rebuilt around Hallowed Mist, with the refund stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[0] is titled 'Build armor vs her AP' but its body was boilerplate, and no lane-facing field mentioned anti-heal or on-hit.
audit.why: _missing flags both: A Thousand Cuts heals her off the damage it deals, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades; and Skip 'n Slash applies on-hit with bonus attack speed, so armour alone reads the trade wrong. Snip Snip! also deals true damage in its centre.
audit.corrected: Added to dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d and wants.you[2].
